about: Curated evidence for live_readiness.assess. A 'pass' earns credit only if 'source' is an existing repository file and every '::Name' it cites is defined there. Paper and offline evidence only: nothing here was exercised against Zerodha or real money. Quantitative criteria are never listed here; they are measured from real trades by the caller.

backtest.walk_forward.detail: Fixed-parameter walk-forward with boundary and window-attribution tests. Synthetic data only.

backtest.costs.detail: Fees, slippage, participation-limited partial fills, rejections and delay in validation_lab.simulate (see the other ExecutionTests).

backtest.lookahead_guard.detail: Changing future bars never changes earlier trades; indicator prefix tests in tests/test_indicators.py.

backtest.corporate_actions.detail: Split, bonus and dividend back-adjustment. Not verified on real owner-supplied action data.

backtest.cost_stress.detail: No 1.5x, 2x and 3x cost stress over a real strategy result exists.

backtest.bootstrap.detail: The bootstrap and risk-of-ruin tools exist and are tested (tests/test_live_readiness.py), but they have not been run on any real strategy result.

risk.entry_gate.detail: Deterministic, fail-closed entry gate; research failure blocks entries only (tests/test_entry_gate.py).

risk.kill_switch.detail: Offline kill latch exists and is tested (tests/test_execution_controls.py), but it has never closed a real broker position.

risk.daily_loss.detail: A loss beyond the daily threshold sets riskHalted in the paper engine; tests/test_loss_audit_regressions.py shows a halted day blocks entries.

risk.sizing.detail: Cost-aware size bounded by the planned stop loss; the exposure re-check at the fill is tests/test_paper.py::PaperTests::test_entry_rechecks_gap_and_exposure.

risk.period_limits.detail: No weekly or monthly loss limit, no drawdown suspension, no consecutive-loss suspension implemented.

risk.concentration.detail: No sector, correlation or concentration limits implemented.

execution.idempotency.detail: Offline journal: one durable winner, unknown status never resubmitted. Not exercised against the broker.

execution.reconciliation.detail: Paper ledger reconciliation is tested (tests/test_supervision.py, tests/test_eod_report.py); broker-side position and trade reconciliation does not exist.

execution.broker_status.detail: Offline order-state model only (tests/test_execution_journal.py); never exercised against Zerodha order updates.

execution.restart_recovery.detail: Restart comes back disarmed, pauses the ledger and raises an exposure incident (paper).

reliability.ci.detail: Offline unit tests, fixture recovery, bandit (high) and gitleaks in CI.

reliability.crash_recovery.detail: Only clean restarts are tested (tests/test_paper.py); no test kills the process mid-write. SQLite transactions roll back, but that is not verified here.

reliability.chaos.detail: No chaos or disaster-recovery suite (outages, clock drift, manual broker orders) exists.

ai.no_direct_orders.detail: Static guard over all tracked sources with a counted allowlist: the only order submission is Handler.place_order behind LIVE_EXECUTION_READY=False; the selection dispatcher is limited to read-only market-data methods (tested); no module imports app. Names built at runtime (exec) are outside a static check.

ai.drift_calibration.detail: No drift detection or confidence calibration exists.

security.secrets.detail: gitleaks full-history scan in CI; .env is git-ignored.

security.dependency_scan.detail: pip-audit on requirements.txt in CI, report-only (continue-on-error): it does not fail the build.

security.audit_high.detail: bandit high-severity gate only; no independent security audit.

regulatory.sebi_nse.detail: Not verified from official SEBI or NSE sources (see docs/compliance-review-needed.md).

regulatory.zerodha_terms.detail: Zerodha API terms, static IP and order tagging not verified from official sources.

monitoring.alerts.detail: Durable local incident inbox; exposure and token-loss incidents in tests/test_supervision.py. Local only, no messaging.

monitoring.readiness_dashboard.detail: No readiness dashboard in the web interface yet; scripts/readiness_report.py is the command-line version.

monitoring.daily_reports.detail: End-of-day and weekly reports exist (tests/test_eod_report.py) but nothing schedules them; scheduling is an owner action.
